Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.paint

Class PaintState

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.paint.PaintState
public class PaintState extends Object
The mutable tool settings shared by every Tool: the active tool, foreground/background colours, stroke geometry, tool opacity, font, shape fill/stroke flags, flood-fill tolerance, zoom and the antialiasing switch.

One instance lives in PaintFrame and is handed to tools through the PaintContext; changing a setting here takes effect on the next stroke and (for zoom) on the next repaint.
